dishes.make_ahead: Fill the dates with goat's cheese and almond up to 1 day ahead and keep covered in the fridge. Halve the figs and lay the board out on the night

steps.text: Split the dates and fill each with goat's cheese and a toasted almond.
Halve the dried figs.
Lay out on a rough board with shards of cheddar and crackers.

dishes.make_ahead: Cook up to 2 hours ahead and wrap in a tea towel; brush with oil just before serving

steps.text: Mix the flour, yoghurt and salt into a soft dough, knead briefly and divide into 8.
Roll each piece out thin.
Cook in a dry hot pan, 2 minutes a side, until puffed and blistered.
Warm the oil with the garlic, stir in the parsley and brush over the breads.

dishes.make_ahead: Stud and rub the lamb up to 1 day ahead and keep covered in the fridge; make the mint sauce up to 2 days ahead. Roast on the day

steps.text: Stud the lamb with garlic and rosemary, rub with oil and salt.
Roast at 180C until 58C inside, with the potatoes alongside.
Rest.
Mix the mint with sugar, vinegar and boiling water for mint sauce.
Carve and serve.

veg.make_ahead: Stud and rub the cauliflowers up to 1 day ahead and keep covered in the fridge; make the mint sauce up to 2 days ahead. Roast on the night

steps.text: Poke small cuts all over the cauliflowers and stud with the garlic and rosemary. Rub with the olive oil and salt, and halve the potatoes.
Roast at 200C with the potatoes alongside, turning the potatoes once, until the cauliflowers are deep golden and a knife slides into the centre.
Mix the mint with sugar, vinegar and boiling water for mint sauce.
Cut the cauliflowers into wedges and serve with the potatoes and mint sauce.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the batter up to 2 hours ahead; fry just before serving

steps.text: Peel, core and slice the apples into rings.
Whisk the flour, sugar, egg and milk to a smooth batter.
Dip the rings and fry in 180C oil, 2 minutes a side, in batches.
Drain, roll in the cinnamon sugar and serve hot with cream.

dishes.make_ahead: Simmer, cool and strain the ginger syrup up to 5 days ahead and keep in the fridge; add the lemon juice then. Top with soda water and ice to order

steps.text: Grate the ginger.
Simmer with the sugar and water.
Cool, then strain, pressing hard on the ginger.
Stir in the lemon juice.
Divide the syrup between tall glasses of ice and top with soda water.
Stir and add a lime wedge and a thin slice of ginger.
